g.title: Rectangle
g.desc: R4 knows the entire topology - It knows R3 is connected to R1...
g.text: R4 knows the entire topology- It knows R3 is connected to R1 and R2- It knows R5 is connected to R6 and R7.- It knows R1 and R2 are inter-connected.- It knows R6 and R7 are inter-connected.- It knows that 10.1.1.0/24 is connected to R1 and 10.2.1.0/24 to R2, and so on.That knowledge requires more CPU/RAM, but allows for faster convergence.
